name: BepInEx/BepInEx
description: Unity / XNA game patcher and plugin framework supporting Unity Mono, IL2CPP, and .NET framework games. The most widely deployed modding framework for Unity games, powering thousands of mods across popular titles.
score_rationale: The dominant Unity modding framework with 7.6k stars, actively maintained through February 2026, and the foundation for mod ecosystems in Lethal Company, Valheim, and hundreds of other Unity titles.
summary: Industry-leading Unity modding framework powering thousands of game mods
